# Domain schema metrics/v0

Measurements: every entity carries a numeric `data.value`, and optionally a `data.unit`. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/metrics/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/metrics/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/metrics/v0.json).

An extraction in this schema is an [extraction](extraction.md) whose `schema` is `metrics/v0`; the extraction schema applies this one
to it.

## Typed data

The engine checks every typed field, and reports a violation at its path. Other `data` fields are open JSON.

### Entities

| Kind | Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Every kind | `data.value` | number | Yes | The measurement. |
| Every kind | `data.unit` | string |  | The measurement's unit, an exact label such as `lines` or `ms`. |
